tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels and the review list.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, Findings, menus. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, Suggested Fixes, the incomplete-coverage notice, and inset areas inside a surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons (3:1 on bg and surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on bg, surface, surface-sunken and every -soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and file paths, on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: primary action, links, selection and focus. As text, on bg, surface or accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind accent text: selected rows, the active tab.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (the primary button's label).

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Critical Severity only. As text, on surface, bg or critical-soft. Always paired with a label.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of critical Severity chips.

tokens.name: high
tokens.usage: High Severity only. As text, on surface, bg or high-soft.

tokens.name: high-soft
tokens.usage: Background of high Severity chips.

tokens.name: medium
tokens.usage: Medium Severity only. As text, on surface, bg or medium-soft.

tokens.name: medium-soft
tokens.usage: Background of medium Severity chips.

tokens.name: low
tokens.usage: Low Severity only. As text, on surface, bg or low-soft.

tokens.name: low-soft
tokens.usage: Background of low Severity chips and neutral badges.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: The + sign and added-line markers in code. Never used outside code.

tokens.name: diff-add-soft
tokens.usage: Background of added lines in diffs; ink text on it.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: The - sign and removed-line markers in code. Never used outside code.

tokens.name: diff-del-soft
tokens.usage: Background of removed lines in diffs; ink text on it.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: A connection that works (GitHub, a Model Provider): its status dot. Always next to text that says so.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Set-up not finished, such as a GitHub App not yet created: its status dot. Always next to text that says so.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: A connection that is unreachable or rejected: its status dot. Also the border and message of an invalid text field; as text, on surface or bg.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: A connection still being checked: its status dot. Always next to text that says so.

tokens.name: state-running
tokens.usage: Label and marker of a running Review's state badge, on state-running-soft.

tokens.name: state-running-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a running Review's state badge.

tokens.name: state-complete
tokens.usage: Label and marker of a complete Review's state badge, on state-complete-soft.

tokens.name: state-complete-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a complete Review's state badge.

tokens.name: state-unsaved
tokens.usage: Label, marker and dashed border of an Unsaved Review's state badge, on state-unsaved-soft.

tokens.name: state-unsaved-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an Unsaved Review's state badge.

tokens.name: state-outdated
tokens.usage: Label and marker of an Outdated Review's state badge, on state-outdated-soft.

tokens.name: state-outdated-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an Outdated Review's state badge.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of accent, so a theme that moves accent moves links.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans in six steps. Weight does the hierarchy work; size changes are rare.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Every pull request, read in full
styles.usage: Landing page and empty-state headlines only. One per view.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Add user search and profile editing
styles.usage: Page titles: the pull request or repository name.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: User input reaches a SQL query

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The q parameter is interpolated into the query string, so a crafted search can read any table.
styles.usage: Default UI and Finding text. Keep lines under 80 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, form labels and badges. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, counts and helper text, in ink-muted.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for code and file paths only, never for UI labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Diffs, Suggested Fixes, inline code and file:line locations.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use the named steps; 24 and 32 separate sections, 12 and 16 sit inside components.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; gap between severity bars.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; vertical padding of card headers.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; code line inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between Findings; page gutters on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections; page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above page titles and around empty states.

radius.note: Small and precise. Radius grows with the size of the thing: chips 3, controls 6, panels 10.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, Severity chips, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, Findings, panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and status dots only.

shadow.note: Borders do most of the work. Shadows are for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest, together with a line border.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts and dialogs.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px gap, then a 2px accent ring.
